atoms.b: The skeleton is the structure that gives the body its shape. Without our bones we would be all ((++floppy rigid)). When babies are born, they have between 270 and 300 bones and, as we grow, some of them fuse together. By the time we are adults we have ((++206 5)) bones.

Humans, like all mammals, are ((++vertebrates invertebrates)) and have their skeleton on the ((++inside outside)) of their body. Whereas some animals, like ((++crabs monkeys)), have their skeleton on the outside.

hint.label: Invertebrates
hint.text: Invertebrates are animals that don’t have a spine, such as worms or spiders. Some invertebrates have an exoskeleton, meaning that their skeleton is on the outside of their body.

instruction.text: Are these statements true or false?

atoms.a: Humans are invertebrates and have an exoskeleton.
The skeleton helps give us our shape.
All mammals have their skeleton on the inside of their body.
Babies have more bones than adults.

atoms.b: The skeleton has many roles in the body. Our bones can ((++protect damage)) our organs. For example, your ribs form a cage around your heart and ((++lungs intestines)).
The spine supports our ((++structure eyes)) and helps us to stay straight. It also has the important job of protecting the ((++spinal_nerve brain)).
Joints are points where two bones meet, like knees and ((++elbows the_head)), and are very helpful when we need to bend.

instruction.text: Choose the correct ending of the sentence about the skeleton.

atoms.a: Knees and elbows are joints which allow us to...
atoms.sound: Knees and elbows are joints which allow us to bend and move about.

atoms.a: Some bones help us to maintain our structure, like...
atoms.b: the spine, which keeps our back straight.
atoms.sound: Some bones help us to maintain our structure, like the spine, which keeps our backs straight.

atoms.a: Bones can also protect our organs, like...
atoms.b: our ribs, which keep our heart and lungs safe.
atoms.sound: Bones can also protect our organs, like our ribs, which keep our heart and lungs safe.

atoms.a: When we are fully grown adults, we have...
atoms.sound: When we are fully grown adults, we have 206 bones.

atoms.sound: When babies are born, they have between 270 and 300 bones.
